import datetime
import difflib
import hashlib
import json
import os
import shutil
import subprocess
import tempfile
from pathlib import Path

ROOT = Path.cwd()
OUT = ROOT / "artifacts/hs0002-20260910"
HELPER = "scripts/verify/has-kickoff-failure.py"
SHELL = "scripts/acceptance-hs-kickoff-mutations.sh"
TEST = "humansearch/tests/test_hs_0002.py"
FILES = [HELPER, SHELL, TEST]
ORIGINALS = {name: (ROOT / name).read_bytes() for name in FILES}
ENV = {k: v for k, v in os.environ.items() if not k.startswith("GIT_") and k not in {"BASH_ENV", "ENV"}}
PYTHON = str(ROOT / "humansearch/.venv/bin/python")
MUTANTS = [
    ("normal", HELPER, None, None),
    ("always-allow", HELPER, '    if not expected or', '    return True\n    if not expected or'),
    ("always-reject", HELPER, '    if not expected or', '    return False\n    if not expected or'),
    ("omit-boundary", HELPER, 'if not suffix or suffix[0] in " \\t/":', 'if True:'),
    ("omit-fail-prefix", HELPER, 'line.startswith("FAIL: ")', 'line.startswith(("FAIL: ", "PASS: "))'),
    ("legacy-substring", HELPER, 're.fullmatch(LEGACY_REASONS[expected], message)', 're.search(LEGACY_REASONS[expected], message)'),
    ("empty-allowed", HELPER, '    if not expected or', '    if not expected:\n        return True\n    if not expected or'),
    ("restore-grep", SHELL, 'python3 scripts/verify/has-kickoff-failure.py "$TMP/out.log" "$expect"', '/usr/bin/grep -q -- "$expect" "$TMP/out.log"'),
]
records = []
for name, target, old, new in MUTANTS:
    with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix="hs0002-g-") as temporary:
        tree = Path(temporary)
        for relative in FILES:
            destination = tree / relative
            destination.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
            destination.write_bytes(ORIGINALS[relative])
        shutil.copyfile(ROOT / "humansearch/pyproject.toml", tree / "humansearch/pyproject.toml")
        before = (tree / target).read_text()
        if old is not None:
            assert before.count(old) == 1, (name, old)
            (tree / target).write_text(before.replace(old, new))
        difference = "".join(difflib.unified_diff(before.splitlines(True), (tree / target).read_text().splitlines(True), fromfile=target, tofile=target))
        (OUT / f"g-{name}.diff").write_text(difference)
        command = [PYTHON, "-m", "pytest", "-q", "tests/test_hs_0002.py"]
        started = datetime.datetime.now(datetime.timezone.utc).isoformat()
        result = subprocess.run(command, cwd=tree / "humansearch", env=ENV, text=True, stdout=subprocess.PIPE, stderr=subprocess.STDOUT)
        (OUT / f"g-{name}.log").write_text(result.stdout)
        record = {"name": name, "command": command, "cwd": str(tree / "humansearch"), "started": started,
                  "ended": datetime.datetime.now(datetime.timezone.utc).isoformat(), "exit_code": result.returncode,
                  "session": "hs0002-g", "head": subprocess.check_output(["git", "rev-parse", "HEAD"], text=True).strip(),
                  "files": {f: hashlib.sha256((tree / f).read_bytes()).hexdigest() for f in FILES},
                  "output_file": f"g-{name}.log", "diff_file": f"g-{name}.diff"}
        records.append(record)
        print(name, result.returncode, result.stdout.splitlines()[-1], flush=True)
        assert (result.returncode == 0) if name == "normal" else (result.returncode == 1 and " failed" in result.stdout), record
(OUT / "g-mutants.json").write_text(json.dumps(records, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2) + "\n")
assert all((ROOT / name).read_bytes() == data for name, data in ORIGINALS.items())
print("PASS: normal passed; 7 mutants rejected; source bytes unchanged")
